title: Event
description: A domain event applied to an Aggregate. The payload is a JSON object; each key sets, deletes, or moves the corresponding top-level node.

id.description: Unique event identifier. Recorded as eventId in node provenance.

type.description: Event type discriminator. Required. Recorded as eventType in node provenance.

seq.description: Monotonic sequence number. Use 1, 2, 3... for synthetic ordering or time.Now().UnixNano() for time-ordered domains. Recoverable as a time via Event.Time().

payload.description: Key/value changes to apply. Each key names a top-level node in the aggregate.

payloadValue.description: null marks the node deleted; {"__moveTo":[...]} moves it; any other value sets it.

moveDirective.description: Moves the source node to the target path. Intermediate Object nodes are created as needed.

__moveTo.description: Path segments naming the target node. One segment: same-level rename. Multiple segments: cross-level move with intermediate objects created as needed.
